title.zh: SEC and CFTC Chairmen Say They Will Write Crypto Rules Without CLARITY Act
title.en: SEC and CFTC Chairmen Say They Will Write Crypto Rules Without CLARITY Act

current_state.zh: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins and CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said they will proceed with writing crypto regulations through their agencies after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act.
current_state.en: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins and CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said they will proceed with writing crypto regulations through their agencies after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act.
